source_caption:
🎬 Chances Are (1989)

Chances Are follows Louie Jeffries, a happily married young man whose life comes to a tragic end after a sudden accident. Years later, he is reincarnated as Alex Finch, a young man who unexpectedly begins remembering his previous life. When Alex crosses paths with Louie’s former wife, Corinne, and their daughter, Miranda, his strange connection to the family creates hilarious misunderstandings, emotional complications, and an unusual romantic situation. As memories from his past become clearer, Alex struggles to understand his feelings while discovering that life has given him an extraordinary second chance. Starring Robert Downey Jr., Cybill Shepherd, Ryan O’Neal, and Mary Stuart Masterson, the film combines charming comedy, heartfelt romance, and supernatural fantasy while exploring love, destiny, family, and the possibility that some connections are powerful enough to last beyond a lifetime.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m • PG

🎥 Director: Emile Ardolino

✍️ Writers: Perry Howze & Randy Howze
